privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
title: Per-repo coherence read by a fresh-context agent, one checklist item per repository (9)
goal: One finding list per repository: what is inconsistent, unclear or too long, with file and line
acceptance: for each of the 9 components (nerv, gauntlet-protocol, project-harness, fpvbuddy, grover, openbando, hobo, bricks, coordinator) a fresh-context agent reads AGENTS.md, BACKLOG-RULES, the procedures it links and the open records at the repository's main, and lists: contradictions between rules; the same rule in two places; dead links; a term used in two senses; a procedure not reachable from the AGENTS.md procedures table; pages and records over their token budget (check:backlog and check:rules warnings quoted); a decision question or Check an owner cannot answer as written (plain-language test: could the owner answer without a re-explanation, as harness F-102-T01, coordinator B-007 and nerv F-132-T04 needed)
the findings are written to docs/reviews/2026-11-coherence/<repo>.md here (one page per repository), each finding with the revision read; no component is edited
the same agent proposes, as its first output, the freeze line for each other repository (this record owns this repository's line); the owner decides in T05

effort.basis: 9 repositories at about 0.4 h each (3 in parallel, one fresh agent per repo with a short brief). Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed for coordinator-only work. Not a measurement.
